description: This file defines the ContentFragment class, which is a subclass of Fragment used in an Android application. It manages the display of a page within a ViewPager, including setting titles and colors based on arguments provided during instantiation.

classes.name: ContentFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass used to display page content in a ViewPager, including title, indicator color, and divider color.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ContentFragment and sets its arguments for title and colors.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for this fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the view components with data from arguments, setting text and colors for display.
